title: Charge rare normalized-input access through starts and activations
statement: In the explicit stationary rank2 diagonal-qubit family with rare start probability eta in(0,1),unknown probe bit and known activation probability lambda in[0,1),any adaptive acquisition with at most R starts and A activation opportunities has worst-case failure>=one-half(1-eta)^R(1-lambda)^A for prediction TV error tolerance<1/2 on the normalized rare input. Herald-and-probe attains the exponent,with at most R+A+1 native calls.

requires: Uniform next-probe prediction after a legal positive-probability rare history
Specified known start/activation opportunities and unknown rare probe bit; true rank2 exhaustive core may even be granted
provides: With lambda=0,unbounded within-episode calls cannot replace rare starts
Same-information matched herald strategy pays all failed preparations
assumptions: At fixed eta,lambda this is a resource requirement,not impossibility at every finite budget
Not an unconditional starting-law lower bound; with lambda=0 those laws differ by at most eta
Deployment abort clock does not manufacture acquisition access
costs: R independent starts plus herald/activation/probe calls
Only actual activation calls earn the A term
Rank alone gives no finite uniform shot bound as rarity tends to0; inverse core scales with rarity
contract.units: Starts,native interventions and uniform rare-normalized-input failure
contract.obstruction: Does not refute useful unconditional law prediction from the certified start or turn the positive certificate into a universal guarantee.

evidence.range_scope: Substantive independent coordinate/coupling audit and sharp rank2 rare-mode starts/activation bound with matched strategy.

evidence.quote: The universal N952 and N687 goals both remain
evidence.range_scope: Completed warm final u32/U39 review including corrected main-coordinate/source deltas,count-only replay,actual exposure and matched conventional alternative.

body: Couple every potential rare opportunity,including unused opportunities under adaptive stopping. Testing separation and a matching ordinary strategy establish the claimed exponent.

review.scope: Actual completed audit is a separate version-bound overlay.
